# JSDoc Command Prompt Example

Use this prompt to request detailed JSDoc documentation for functions with object parameters:

---

Add a detailed JSDoc block to this function. Use the standard syntax to document each property of object-type parameters, for example:

```
/**
 * Brief description of the function.
 *
 * @param options - General description of the options object.
 * @param options.filenames - Description of filenames.
 * @param options.directory - Description of directory.
 * @param options.tagName - Description of tagName.
 * @param options.header - Description of header.
 * @returns Description of the return value.
 */
```

Make sure to describe each property of the options object and the return value.
